title: AWL Sublist 1
description: Academic Word List — nhóm 1: những từ học thuật xuất hiện dày nhất

words.example: Researchers analysed the survey data.
words.collocation: analyse data · carefully analyse · analyse the results

words.example: The school adopted a new approach to teaching.
words.collocation: a new approach · adopt an approach · practical approach

words.example: Experts assessed the damage after the storm.
words.collocation: assess the impact · assess risk · carefully assess

words.example: We cannot assume the trend will continue.
words.collocation: assume responsibility · reasonably assume

words.example: The local authority approved the plan.
words.collocation: local authority · in authority · exercise authority

words.example: Regular exercise has many health benefits.
words.collocation: major benefit · reap the benefits · of great benefit

words.example: Students struggled with the abstract concept.
words.collocation: abstract concept · grasp a concept · key concept

words.example: The team consists of six members.
words.collocation: consist of · mainly consist of

words.example: Women constitute half the workforce.
words.collocation: constitute a threat · constitute a majority

words.example: The word's meaning depends on context.
words.collocation: in this context · social context · historical context

words.example: It is hard to define happiness precisely.
words.collocation: clearly define · define a term · define a goal

words.example: Many English words derive from Latin.
words.collocation: derive from · derive benefit · derive pleasure

words.example: Aid was distributed to the flood victims.
words.collocation: distribute evenly · distribute aid · widely distributed

words.example: The economy grew by three percent.
words.collocation: global economy · booming economy · stimulate the economy

words.example: The charity was established in 1990.
words.collocation: establish a company · firmly establish · establish a link

words.example: Experts estimate the population at ten million.
words.collocation: estimate the cost · roughly estimate · conservatively estimate

words.example: It was evident that she was upset.
words.collocation: clearly evident · become evident · self-evident

words.example: The country exports coffee worldwide.
words.collocation: export goods · export oil · export to

words.example: Cost is a key factor in the decision.
words.collocation: key factor · contributing factor · decisive factor

words.example: She works in corporate finance.
words.collocation: personal finance · public finance · finance minister

words.example: There is no magic formula for success.
words.collocation: a simple formula · secret formula · apply a formula

words.example: The primary function of a fridge is to keep food cold.
words.collocation: primary function · perform a function · basic function

words.example: Doctors identified the cause of the illness.
words.collocation: identify a problem · correctly identify · identify a trend

words.example: Households on a low income get extra support.
words.collocation: annual income · disposable income · source of income

words.example: The data indicate a rise in demand.
words.collocation: clearly indicate · results indicate · indicate a trend
